title: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S.
summary: Amazon's planned data center in Texas could become the largest source of climate pollution in the U.S., releasing 33 million tons of carbon dioxide per year. The data center will be powered by an on-site natural gas power plant, which is permitted to emit more pollution than any other U.S. power plant. This development is concerning, especially given Amazon's pledge to eliminate its carbon emissions by 2040 and its recent 16% increase in carbon emissions last year.

title: Google DeepMind enters a new era as co-founder Demis Hassabis shifts AI role - The Guardian
summary: Google DeepMind co-founder Demis Hassabis is shifting his role within the company, marking a new era for the AI research organization. This change comes as DeepMind has grown significantly since its acquisition by Google in 2014, with its AI technology being applied in various fields such as healthcare and climate modeling. The shift in Hassabis' role is expected to have a significant impact on the direction of DeepMind's research and development, potentially leading to new breakthroughs in AI technology.

title: Latest scoop: Demis Hassabis actually wants to leave too, but Google is getting cold feet. - 36 Kr
